title: Out of the Dark Nebula

As they fight to survive against overwhelming odds, the crew faces internal dangers, including infiltrators disguised as crew members. The tension escalates as they navigate through battles, personal losses, and the pressure of reliance on inexperienced soldiers. Ultimately, through a combination of skill and unexpected circumstances, the crew of the "Albion" contributes to a decisive victory for the Solar Federation, highlighting the themes of bravery and resilience in the face of adversity.
